scope: Diagnostics only; actual browser measurement pending

required: paused refresh advances on wall time
reset removes prior stalls and waits for fresh frame interval
mature save visible scene measurement at fixed quality/speed
raw FPS reflects actual frame gap rather than capped simulation delta

limits: Drawing measures CPU submission, not GPU execution
Simulation samples are per fixed step; other rows per operation
Per-stage samples and frame gaps are bounded rolling histories since reset
Unmeasured audio/camera/ghost/React rendering overhead can also affect total gaps
Automatic graphics reduction can change quality; record final actual quality for every measured window

rendererExtension.scope: All submitted passes in one WorldView.render invocation; explicit once-per-frame reset, including partial compositor and fallback submissions

units.renderCounts: drawing calls, triangles, lines, points per complete frame
units.resources: geometries, textures, programs are counts; not GPU memory bytes
units.optionalHeap: browser JS heap estimate in MiB, absent if unsupported

rendererExtension.navigation: Included in simulation CPU; no separately measured navigation duration
rendererExtension.browserQa: pending root actual mature-save reset windows; no gate credit claimed
